## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

If every cocycle of a declared F2 cochain complex is exact, then no residual is ClosedResidual.

### Governing Obligation
None for the lemma; its use on the legacy carrier needs the legacy dim H1 = 0 measurement (MAJ-C13).

### Witness Audit
legacy_carrier_obstruction takes h_trivial_h1 : forall w, is_cocycle C w -> is_exact C w and returns forall w, not is_closed_residual C w; statement matches. The Rust test samples 120 residuals on the 3x3 disk and sees only Exact or OpenObstruction.
